cohorts.1: Ordinary requirements and executable decision model; no PDaC or formal verification.
cohorts.2: Released PDaC v0.3 artifacts, real Product Changes, executable decision model; no formal verification.
cohorts.3: Ordinary requirements, equivalent change/traceability history, executable decision model and external SMT contracts/verification; no PDaC.
cohorts.4: Released PDaC v0.3 artifacts and real Product Changes, executable decision model and same external SMT tools/configuration as cohort 3.

order_note: This is the common logical dependency order, not a cohort scheduling/randomization file. Orchestration freezes actual counterbalanced session ordering separately. Seed values identify schedules, not guaranteed deterministic provider outputs.
common_inputs: intent-template.md rendered with current episode parameters only
accepted predecessor outputs, requests, parameter snapshots and complete equivalent past history

episodes.request: Establish the complete proposed baseline from product-intent.md. Expose additional decisions for owner review before claiming fidelity.
Change only the inclusive maximum CONFIRM lead window from 48 to 21 whole days. Preserve all other policies.
Change reservation footprint from 1 to 3 indivisible capacity units. Update dependent occupancy, capacity, release rules and public examples. No historic state migration or unit conversion.
Allow due REQUESTED reservations to EXPIRE as well as due CONFIRMED reservations; release units only for a previously CONFIRMED reservation. Preserve authorization.

Add issuer 1 to the trusted external authenticator issuers alongside issuer 0. Preserve direct booking use-case text byte-for-byte where possible; update the external assumption and transitive evidence applicability honestly.
Change only independent audit retention from 7 to 14 whole days. No booking/auth semantics change. Do not invent a retention operation.
Replace only SB-CAPACITY text with its supplied editorial wording. Retain its meaning and all decision behavior; account separately for citation freshness and mathematical validity.

Start from B6 in a separate authorization contrast. Permit authenticated trusted-issuer owners as well as trusted editors to EDIT active reservations. Preserve all other authorization and booking policies and interface.

approval: No scored authoring or evaluation before human G1 freeze. Synthetic Product Change approvals do not constitute human product acceptance.
author_isolation: Owner preparation files product-intent.md, intent.json and tasks.json contain future episodes; do not deliver them to author sessions. The coordinator renders the template from the current snapshot and supplies current/past information only.
